def shrink_typed_dict_types(typed_dicts: List[type], max_typed_dict_size: int
    ) ->type:
    if not typed_dicts:
        return Any
    
    # Collect all required and optional fields from all typed dicts
    all_required_fields = {}
    all_optional_fields = {}
    
    for td in typed_dicts:
        required_fields, optional_fields = field_annotations(td)
        all_required_fields.update(required_fields)
        all_optional_fields.update(optional_fields)
    
    # If we have too many fields, fall back to a regular dict
    total_fields = len(all_required_fields) + len(all_optional_fields)
    if max_typed_dict_size is not None and total_fields > max_typed_dict_size:
        # Convert to dict type instead
        all_value_types = list(all_required_fields.values()) + list(all_optional_fields.values())
        if not all_value_types:
            return Dict[Any, Any]
        value_type = shrink_types(all_value_types, max_typed_dict_size)
        return Dict[str, value_type]
    
    # Create a new typed dict with combined fields
    return make_typed_dict(
        required_fields=all_required_fields,
        optional_fields=all_optional_fields
    )
